answer: Using the displayed adjusted-equity values, (31.5 - 31.7) / 31.7 × 100 = -0.6309%, approximately a 0.63% year-on-year decrease. The arithmetic difference is -0.2 Mt CO2e, consistent with the issuer's statement that gross emissions decreased by 0.2 Mt CO2e. These adjusted-equity values must not be mixed with the separate actual-equity table.

evidence.quote: Our 2025 gross Scope 1 and 2 greenhouse gas emissions (adjusted equity basis) were 31.5 Mt CO2e, a reduction of 0.2 Mt CO2e from the previous year.
